description: This file defines the ShoppingCartItem class, which models an item in a shopping cart including attributes like name, price, quantity, product details, and associated attributes.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart with attributes like name, price, quantity, product details, and customizable options.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shopping cart item.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the shopping cart item.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price as a string.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price as a string.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the item.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the item.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the shopping cart code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the shopping cart code.

methods.name: getShoppingCartAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of shopping cart attributes.

methods.name: setShoppingCartAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart attributes.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Sets the product price as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Returns the product price as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID.

methods.name: setProductCode
methods.description: Sets the product code.

methods.name: getProductCode
methods.description: Returns the product code.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal as a string.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal as a string.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.
